{{Youmay|the creature|the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] individual named [[Weazel/Legends|Weazel]]}}
{{Quote|Why did you call me a schutta? What does it mean?''"<br />"''I spoke harshly. A schutta is a weasel creature in my language.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Mazie]]|<ref name="PtT">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref>}}
A '''weasel''' was a creature that was similar to the [[Schutta/Legends|schutta]] in [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] culture.<ref name="PtT" /> The [[Mostlaa]] were considered to appear weasel-like.<ref name="Smoking">{{WEGCite|story=Tales of the Smoking Blaster|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook|stext=Tales of the ''Smoking Blaster''}}</ref> Similarly named creatures included the [[womp weasel]],<ref name="Shadow">''[[Jedi Quest: The Shadow Trap]]''</ref> the [[bladderweasel]],<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> and the [[scampweasel]].<ref name="Secret">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]''</ref> The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Karl Mathieu Ancher|Karl Ancher]] once deliberately mispronounced the name of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Vessle]] as "weasel."<ref name="Domino">{{JournalCite|3|When the Domino Falls}}</ref> [[Dellin Sorth]], proprietor of [[Club Prosperine]] on [[Algara II]], was considered by some to exhibit smarmy, weasel-like qualities.<ref name="Planets">''[[The Star Wars Planets Collection]]''</ref> The [[Sessehshellah]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[mustalid]]s [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shaymore]], had the temperament of weasels and the physical features of giant river [[Otter/Legends|otters]].<ref name="RoBW">{{WEGCite|story=Rings of Bright Water|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
